cases.name: actor-scope-original-command-envelopes
cases.expected: For three original RR-P03 publication command vectors, Scope/Actor bytes equal independent literal closed sorted property envelopes copied from original bytes, preserving assessmentId and numeric-string securityVersion.

cases.name: publish-and-read-existing-originalbytes
cases.expected: Bound Publish/Read bytes equal unchanged original command/read-request vectors and SHA256; native codec called only by source, never regenerate independent golden bytes.

cases.name: bound-returnedbytes-ownership
cases.expected: Mutating CopyBytes output does not alter later copy or digest; returned bytes have separate ownership.

cases.name: bound-meaning-canonical-equivalence
cases.expected: Command/request constructor copies with canonical-equal content, and only excluded correlation/invocation changes where allowed, match; actor/scope/resource/revision/digest/operation/warning tuple semantic changes refuse.

cases.name: bound-admission-exact-owner
cases.expected: Exact actor/scope/purpose/resource/originaloperation and zero-offset deadline admission match; null or any changed binding/purpose or nonzero offset refuses. Actual deadline currentness remains original lease/session obligation.

cases.name: token-copy-ordinal-set
cases.expected: Tokens copies caller collection, sorts ordinal ASCII closed token grammar, rejects null/empty/129character/control/slash/nonASCII/duplicate; valid empty and grammar boundary serialize exact arrays.

cases.name: fixed-binding-no-empty-or-null
cases.expected: Customer/Stream/WriterBindingReferences all nonzero required; null and each zero refuse with closed argument error.

cases.name: clock-utc7-exactticks
cases.expected: Exact UTC7 native value equals server ticks; tick mismatch/nonUTC/precision/calendar/null/offset alias refuses with fixed integrity marker.

cases.name: null-invalid-typed-before-fields
cases.expected: Null actor/scope/commands/requests and zero or invalid scalar objects refuse via fixed marker/argument error before field access, not null dereference.

cases.name: digest-independent-known-bytes
cases.expected: Digest equals independent SHA256 known literal bytes including empty, ASCII, embedded NUL and raw UTF8; lowercase64hex without prefix.
